title: Frappe ERPNext 14.44.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 14.44.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contain a missing authorization vulnerability in the Accounts module's payment unreconciliation endpoint. This flaw allows authenticated users with the Accounts User role to send crafted requests to unreconcile payments on vouchers outside their permissions or from other companies. The vulnerability does not check the caller's permission on the vouchers it unreconciles.
